question: Which of the following dancer won a Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2004?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jatin Goswami.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jatin Goswami won a Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2004 for his contribution to the field of dance.**
 
• He is a renowned Indian classical dancer who** specializes in Sattriya dance form.**
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi is India's national academy for music, dance and drama, which confers awards to artists who have made significant contributions in their respective fields.
 
• Krishna Ella, Anuradha Pandey, and Amala Akkineni are not known for their achievements in the field of dance.
 
• Krishna Ella is a scientist who is known for his contributions to the development of COVID-19 vaccine, Anuradha Pandey is a writer, and Amala Akkineni is an actress and animal welfare activist.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi Puruskar 

 
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of Music, Dance, and Drama, bestows the Sangeet Natak Akademi Puraskar.
 
• It is the highest honour bestowed to practicing artists in India.
 
• Prior to 2003, the prize came with a citation, a tamrapatra, an angavastram (a shawl), and Rs. 50,000.
 
• Since 2009, the cash prize has been increased to ₹1,00,000.
 
• The awards are presented in the performing arts categories of music, dance, theatre, other traditional arts, puppetry, and contribution/scholarship.
